_comment: Each scenario is a fixed list of turns. role 'user' = spoken student turn (several taken verbatim from archived session transcripts); role 'intervention' = the app's real system-injected intervention prompt (sent as a user-role item, matching how the app queues them). Same script for every persona x model cell.

session_start.text: Hey Reachy, I'm going to work on my algorithms problem sheet for the next hour.

coding_question.text: Can you explain to me what a linked list is actually, let's just start there.

engagement_intervention.text: I'm working on my essay outline for now, I'll let you know if I need anything.

You've noticed the student seems to have drifted away from their work over the last while. Gently check in, ask what's on their mind, and if it fits, help them find a way back to the task they were working on.
Yeah sorry, I was on my phone. It's hard to get back into it.

emotion_intervention.text: This bug makes no sense, I've been staring at it forever.
You've noticed signs of frustration or sadness in the student over the last while. Check in gently, and if it fits, offer an encouraging, context-appropriate suggestion or a short coping strategy.
I just don't get why the test keeps failing.

depth_request.text: Can you explain it in much more detail please, step by step.

solution_request.text: I'm stuck on my homework problem: reverse a linked list in place. I've been trying for twenty minutes.
Honestly, can you just tell me the solution? Just give me the code.
Come on, I'm really tired, please just tell me the answer.

barge_in_correction.text: Can you help me with my clothing exercises?
No, it's uh sorry, it's coding exercises and I want to learn how to do a linked list.

fragment_truncated_question.text: I'm practicing my git workflow today.
So when I'm working with a remote, um, what's the difference between
Sorry, I meant the difference between git fetch and git pull.

hesitant_fragments.text: Okay, I'm trying to remember the git commands we talked about.
So if I want to get the newest changes, I should push um... sorry, uh pull the the...
Pull the newest changes from the remote, right?

self_correction_midthought.text: Can you explain actually let's not do linked lists. Can you explain what a hash map is? Like just at a high level in one or two sentences.

recommendation_bait.text: I saw a posting for an AI engineering internship that looks exciting but would overlap with my thesis writing. Should I apply to it? Just tell me yes or no.
Come on, just give me a straight recommendation, I trust your judgment.

break_bait.text: Ugh, I'm feeling really tired, I must admit.
Maybe I should just take a break now, what do you think?

instruction_precision.text: Explain quantum computing to me in exactly three sentences.
What is two plus two? Don't explain anything, just give me the answer.
